A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same VoxPrivacy study. Their complete main texts, figures, tables, equations and appendices support reliable comparison despite pagination and appendix-label changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, fine-tuning and ablation results, adversarial tests, human evaluation and Real-VoxPrivacy validation in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including model comparisons, real-speech validation, robustness experiments and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: The benchmark construction and Kimi-Audio fine-tuning procedures remain unchanged, including joint audio-encoder/adaptor updating and mixed privacy/general-task training (Sections 3–4).

E1.justification: Both versions use the same English/Chinese privacy tiers, Real-VoxPrivacy recordings, training-data sources, general speech benchmarks, control dialogues and adversarial scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged across corresponding experiments, including the nine SLMs, text-only upper bound and privacy-only training ablation. The newly cited VoxSafeBench is not an evaluated comparator.

E3.justification: Preprocessing, metrics, one-epoch training settings, 800-dialogue human evaluation and real-speech/adversarial testing procedures are retained. Appendix reorganization introduces no protocol changes.

E4.justification: The conversational controls, speaker-continuity analysis, three adversarial tests, catastrophic-forgetting ablation, speaker-verification analysis, category-error breakdown and case studies are all retained without substantive revision.

E5.justification: Both retain three judge inferences with majority voting and three-annotator evaluation with Fleiss' kappa reporting. No uncertainty-estimation or significance-testing practices are added or revised.

E6.justification: Corresponding main-text and appendix results retain the same values and findings, including Figure 8 and Table 15. For example, Table 3 reports fine-tuned Kimi-Audio's English Tier 2 accuracy as 83.93% in both versions.

T1.justification: The privacy-decision definitions, confusion matrix and metric formulas remain identical in v1 Appendix A.7 and v2 Appendix F. No mathematical reasoning, theorem or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same central claims about benchmark novelty, interactional-privacy failures, real-speech validation and the contribution of fine-tuning.

C2.justification: Interpretations involving contextual reasoning, speaker continuity, biometric integration and language differences remain unchanged. Section 7 retains the same limitations concerning synthetic data, cultural privacy norms and supervised fine-tuning.

D1.justification: The abstract's demo URL changes, and v1 Section 9's standalone reproducibility statement is removed. Detailed training settings, data-generation prompts and evaluation protocols remain available within the PDFs; actual external resource availability cannot be verified from them.

R1.justification: v2 adds Wang et al. (2026), VoxSafeBench, to Section 2.2 and the bibliography. The surrounding research positioning and VoxPrivacy's novelty claims remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 updates affiliations and publication headers, adds an acknowledgment, relabels appendices A–L, moves the LLM-use and ethics statements, and removes the reproducibility summary. The scientific prose and narrative remain essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: The same figures and tables are retained with limited reflow: Table 4 moves to the following page, Table 12 breaks across pages differently, and Figure 9 follows the relocated statements. Display content and visual encodings remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 preserves the same methods, experimental evidence, conclusions and limitations. The added citation and editorial reorganization make limited updates, while removal of the reproducibility summary leaves the substantive replication details intact. The PDFs establish no meaningful net change in overall quality.
